questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. My dog / barks / very louder / at night.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
My dog / barks / very louder / at night.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of "very louder".

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. A comic play was performed by the comedian.

Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.
A comic play was performed by the comedian.

options.text: The comedian performs a comic play.

options.text: The comedian performed a comic play.

options.text: The comedian performance a comic play.
options.html: The comedian performance a comic play.

options.text: The comedian do perform a comic play.

questions.solution:
```html
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "A comic play was performed by the comedian."
  • To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the comedian" at the beginning.
  • Change the passive verb form "was performed" to "performed" (simple past active).
```

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Raj is very interested in studying human psychology, so he decided to pursue his master’s degree in ________.

  • Archaeology is the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains. (पुरातत्त्व विज्ञान)
    • Example: Archaeologists discovered ancient tools that provided insight into early human life.
  • Philosophy is the study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence, especially when considered as an academic discipline. (दर्शनशास्त्र)
    • Example: She is majoring in philosophy to explore questions about existence and ethics.
  • Anatomy is the branch of science concerned with the bodily structure of humans, animals, and other living organisms. (शरीर रचना विज्ञान)
    • Example: Medical students must study human anatomy to understand the body's structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Psychology.

questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence. (A) and was searching for them (B) the grandmother couldn’t find (C) all around the house (D) placed them on her head (E) her spectacles because she had
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
(A) and was searching for them
(B) the grandmother couldn’t find
(C) all around the house
(D) placed them on her head
(E) her spectacles because she had
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • Part (B) should come first as it introduces the subject and what she couldn’t find, "the grandmother couldn’t find":
    • "the grandmother couldn’t find"
  • Part (E) follows to explain what she couldn’t find, "her spectacles because she had":
    • "her spectacles because she had"
  • Part (D) follows to give the reason why she couldn’t find them, "placed them on her head":
    • "placed them on her head"
  • Part (A) comes next to show the action taken due to not finding spectacles, "and was searching for them":
    • "and was searching for them"
  • Part (C) comes last to show where the search happened, "all around the house":
    • "all around the house"
  • The correct sequence is BEDAC.
 
Coherent sentence after rearrangement:
"The grandmother couldn’t find her spectacles because she had placed them on her head and was searching for them all around the house."

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. To go through an area making a lot of noise and causing damage

questions.solution:

Key Points

    • Example: The brutality of the attack shocked the entire community.
  • "Cacophony" is a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds. (कर्कश ध्वनि)
    • Example: The cacophony of horns honking and people shouting made it hard to concentrate.
  • "Violence" involves behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something. (हिंसा)
    • Example: There was a lot of violence during the protest.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Rampage.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Brutality (क्रूरता): Savage physical violence; great cruelty.
    • Example: The brutality of the dictator was feared by all.
  • Cacophony (कर्कश ध्वनि): A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds.
    • Example: The cacophony of the city was overwhelming to the countryside visitors.
  • Violence (हिंसा): Behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.

questions.question: Select the option that can substitute/replace the bracketed word correctly and complete the sentence. If he runs, he (get) there in time.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can substitute/replace the bracketed word correctly and complete the sentence.

If he runs, he (get) there in time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. will get.

Key Points

  • The correct option should follow the "if" clause in the future tense.
  • "Will get" correctly follows modals with the base form of the verb to form future tense for conditional sentences.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information

  • "Got there in time" is past tense and does not work with the present/future conditional.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The research team is conducting experiments on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The research team is conducting experiments on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease.

options.text: Experiments have been conducted on a new drug that could have revolutionised the treatment of the disease through the research team.
options.html: Experiments have been conducted on a new drug that could have revolutionised the treatment of the disease through the research team.

options.text: Experiments were being conducted on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease by the research team.

options.html: Experiments are being conducted on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease by the research team.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "The research team is conducting experiments on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease."
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "experiments on a new drug" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "is conducting" to "are being conducted" (present continuous passive).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the research team."
  • Ensure the additional information "that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
Correct Sentence: "Experiments are being conducted on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease by the research team."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "Experiments have been conducted on a new drug that could have revolutionised the treatment of the disease through the research team." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
  • Option 2: "Experiments were being conducted on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease by the research team." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
  • Option 3: "Experiments are conducted on a new drug that could revolutionise the treatment of the disease from the research team." – Incorrect preposition (from instead of by) and tense (present simple).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'region'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "region" refers to a specific geographical area, which fits the context describing the location of Kuno Palpur National Park.
  • The other options do not fit the context correctly:
    • reason: Refers to a cause or explanation, which does not describe a geographical location.
    • reign: Refers to the period during which a sovereign rules, which is not relevant in this context.
    • river: While Chambal is a river, the context requires a term describing a broader geographical area.
Therefore, the correct answer is 'region'.
 
Complete Passage: The Kuno Palpur National Park, located in Madhya Pradesh's Chambal region, has an area of 750 square kilometres. It now has leopards, jackals, spotted deer, sambhar, neelgai, chinkara, wild boar, and four-horned antelope, making it a perfect base for felids. Despite strong objections from Gujarat, which claimed that lions were part of the state's heritage, that MP had a poor record in wildlife management, and that Kuno Palpur had other big cat species that would complicate lion relocation, the sanctuary was chosen for the lion reintroduction project in 2013.
 
Additional Information
  • Reason: Incorrect because it means a cause or explanation, which does not describe a geographical location.
  • Reign: Incorrect because it refers to the period during which a sovereign rules, which is not relevant in this context.
  • River: Incorrect because, while Chambal is a river, the context requires a term describing a broader geographical area.
  • Region: Correct because it refers to a specific geographical area, fitting the context about the National Park's location.
